Reference BLAKE3 compression and round mixing functions.

# Purpose
This file implements the reference compression step for BLAKE3. It defines the core mixing function [`g`](<#g>), the round function [`round_fn`](<#round_fn>), and the block compression path used to process one message block with a chaining value, block counter, length, and flags. The code builds the 16-word internal state from the input chaining value, the BLAKE3 IV, the block counter, the block length, and the flags, then applies the BLAKE3 message schedule across 7 rounds.

The public entry point [`fd_blake3_ref_compress1`](<#fd_blake3_ref_compress1>) provides the main compression interface for one block or for the last block of a chunk. It supports normal hash output and XOF-related chaining output through `out_chain` and `in_chain`, and it handles block flag setup for chunk start, chunk end, parent nodes, and root output. This file is a C implementation file for the BLAKE3 private interface, and it exposes the reference compression routine used by other parts of the BLAKE3 code.
